advisories.limitations: Version floors documented only for 5.2.3 and 6.4.2 trains. Vulnerable 6.1 and 7.0 trains require vendor confirmation; being on an unlisted train never means fixed. Restrictions can interrupt Edge management.

advisories.attribution: Cisco PSIRT cisco-sa-sdwan-webauth-xr8beuuU; Cisco remediation workflow

advisories.product: FreeRTOS-Kernel queue sets on MPU-enabled embedded firmware
advisories.attribution: AWS Security Bulletin 2026-158-AWS / FreeRTOS upstream advisory
advisories.verification: Determine build provenance, MPU port and configUSE_QUEUE_SETS setting; verify FreeRTOS-Kernel V11.3.3 or vendor-backported fix in actual built firmware, signed image, flashed device and post-reboot functioning. Review downstream forks.
advisories.limitations: Only MPU-enabled ports using configUSE_QUEUE_SETS=1 are implicated. Version-only checks cannot establish device build flags, forks or deployed firmware. A FreeRTOS source update is not an installed device firmware patch.

advisories.product: AWS Nitro Enclaves SDK for C and kmstool-enclave example
advisories.attribution: AWS Security Bulletin 2026-157-AWS
advisories.verification: Inventory SDK library version and kmstool-enclave use; upgrade aws-nitro-enclaves-sdk-c to v0.4.6 or later, rebuild enclave images from reviewed source, update signed artifacts and attest/deploy images; test authorized KMS calls after replacement.
advisories.limitations: CVE-2026-119116 applies to kmstool-enclave/derived images; CVE-2026-119148 applies to the SDK library. Parent EC2 OS updates alone do not replace enclave images. AWS states no workaround.

advisories.product: Amazon Kinesis Producer Library for Java
advisories.attribution: AWS Security Bulletin 2026-159-AWS
advisories.verification: Identify Maven group ID and resolved KPL runtime dependency, migrate 0.x to software.amazon.kinesis:amazon-kinesis-producer >=1.0.8, rebuild and deploy, verify live child-process arguments and log pipeline do not expose credentials; rotate/revoke credentials and protect historical logs.
advisories.limitations: Setting the KPL daemon logger to INFO reduces log leakage only; affected native child-process arguments may still reveal credentials. 0.x versions require migration, not a branch-local numeric floor. Credentials already exposed require separate remediation.

advisories.product: Delinea Secret Server on-premises and cloud (JWT, login, FIDO2)
advisories.attribution: Delinea Security Advisories October 30, 2026
advisories.verification: Confirm exact Secret Server product version and cloud tenant patch state; deploy Delinea-supported 12.3.1 update, verify running release and re-test intended JWT issuance, normal login, FIDO2 PIN/biometric enforcement and administrative audit records.
advisories.limitations: Delinea lists affected on-prem and cloud versions 12.2.7 or earlier. A 12.3.1 version check is a reported software-floor comparison only, not confirmation that a cloud tenant is patched or an already compromised environment has recovered.

advisories.attribution: Ivanti Connect Secure advisory; CISA KEV October 30, 2026; Canadian Cyber Centre AV26-1035 update
advisories.verification: Verify exact appliance/hardware release train against Ivanti advisory, with targets including 22.8R2.6 and 25.1.1.3 where applicable. Acquire signed vendor upgrade and preserve off-device incident evidence; run vendor Integrity Checker and perform compromise-specific recovery if indicated.
advisories.limitations: Exploited in the wild; this LPE can be used with an authentication-bypass chain. Numeric comparisons of 22.8R2.x and 25.1.x are not interchangeable. Earlier remediation for CVE-2026-104935 alone may not resolve the full chain. No confirmed complete standalone workaround.

advisories.product: Google Brotli decoder (also bundled in Node.js, .NET and industrial software)
advisories.attribution: Google Brotli GHSA-9v8h-qqgm-4m35; Siemens SSA-045512; Node.js October security releases
advisories.verification: Identify exact Brotli decoder dependency and package provenance across container, native binary and application layers. Use fixed upstream 1.0.10, 1.1.1 or 1.2.1 in the corresponding train, or the vendor-supported runtime/Siemens release. Rebuild redeploy and restart; test legitimate decompression.
advisories.limitations: Brotli decoder version cannot be inferred from the operating system, Node.js/npm wrapper, a Python package name or a Siemens product version. Distinguish encoder-only vs attacker-controlled decoding. Vendor backports and embedded static libraries require independent proof; raw library floor is not a Siemens firmware fix.
